verdict.rationale: Dynadot's API is broad: it covers more than 120 actions across domains, account settings, DNS, orders, smart folders, aftermarket bidding and backorders, reseller management, and register/transfer/renew/delete/push. That suggests wide but unconfirmed coverage of what the UI offers. Nothing in the evidence explicitly claims full UI parity, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement, API coverage evidence for SSL, email, watchlist, grace deletion and security settings (2FA, Registry Lock), a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
